name: Harley-Davidson J / JD (F-head)
engine: 61 or 74 cubic inch air-cooled F-head V-twin, total-loss oiling, atmospheric or pushrod inlet
intro: Harley's early big twins. Inlet over exhaust, total-loss oiling and parts that are mostly reproduction now.

H: Check whether yours has a total-loss or a recirculating oil system before you fill it, and know which one you are running.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
